Name: Furdew Valley
Author: ashvee
Description:
[center]Welcome to Furdew Valley!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2KK2OUw.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]
This mod takes the original Stardew Valley and swaps out all NPCs with furry streamers from Twitch. This is a love project from wanting to add one or two friends to a game, to create a fully new functioning town in Stardew Valley.[/center]
[b]What has been changed in the game?[/b]
[list]
[*]Portrait updates for all characters
[*]Overworld sprite updates for all characters
[*]Unique dialogue changes
[*]Changed likes/dislike items for many characters
[*]Background detail changes to blend in with the furry characters better
[*]New pet designs
[/list]
